Far out in the uncharted backwaters of the unfashionable end of the western spiral arm of the Internet lies a small unregarded server farm.

Situated in this server farm is an utterly insignificant little website whose goat-descended life forms are so amazingly primitive that they still think that the anal insertion counter is a pretty neat idea.

This website has - or rather had - a problem, which was this: most of the people posting on it were unhappy for pretty much of the time. Many solutions were suggested for this problem, but most of these were largely concerned with the creation of new subverses, which is odd because on the whole it wasn't the subverses that were unhappy.

And so the problem remained; lots of the people were mean, and most of them were miserable, even the ones who'd contributed to the anal insertion counter.

Many were increasingly of the opinion that they'd all made a big mistake in coming down from Reddit in the first place. And some suggested that even Reddit had been a bad move, and that no one should ever have left Digg.

Then, one Thursday, nearly a year after one CEO had been forced to resign for saying how great it would be to be nice to people for a change, a girl sitting on her own in a small thread in v/Whatever suddenly realized what it was that had been going wrong all this time, and she finally knew how Voat could be made a good and happy place. This time it was right, it would work, and no one would have to be forced to resign from anything.

Sadly, however, before she could get to a subverse to tell anyone about it, a terribly stupid catastrophe occurred, and the idea was lost forever.

This is not her story.

But it is the story of that terrible stupid catastrophe and some of its consequences.
